description: Self-issued testnet USDC-code asset for demoing takumi_pay. Not affiliated with Circle's real testnet USDC issuer — a separate, independent SAC deployment created purely so we can mint unlimited demo balances without depending on an external faucet.

verifiedEndToEnd.note: create_transaction invoked against takumi_pay using this token; transfer + TransactionCreated events both fired.

pointDepositAllowlisted.note: This SAC is registered as an AllowedPointToken on takumi_pay (required by deposit_points, a separate allowlist from merchant tokens). Owner call add_allowed_point_token(deployer, SAC).

pointDepositVerifiedEndToEnd.note: deposit_points invoked against takumi_pay using this token via the real mobile code (resolveStellarSacId + buildDepositPointsArgs + invokeSorobanContract); get_point_deposit read back wallet_address/token/ref_id/amount all matching — the exact fields the API's verifyPointDeposit checks.
